answer: Each agent must post a bonded stake before acting, and the bond is slashed when independent attestations contradict its claims. A fake cluster must fund every sock-puppet identity, so the cost of sustaining deception scales with each new node rather than staying flat. Honest agents earn a nectar of shared fees for flagging discrepancies, while the daily tide of disputes continuously drains attacker capital. Colluding identities leave a relic of failed stakes that cross-validators audit, making sybil growth economically self-defeating.
